annotations.text:
Aurora Glass — One UI geometry (22px cards, capsule controls, generous padding) over Apple-style layered glass (tint + specular rim + off-axis sheen).

Structure is Windows Voice Recorder: hero waveform, big centred record button, list beneath. Restraint and the mono readouts are Superwhisper.
Palette, meter ramp, type ramp and window size are lifted from the real source — App.xaml's Dark dictionary and MainWindow.xaml.cpp. Nothing here invents a colour.
